description: Source code for SELinux label management in container environments, including label initialization, modification, validation, and sharing checks.

methods.name: InitLabels
methods.description: Initializes process and mount labels for containers based on provided options, handling SELinux context modifications.

methods.name: SetFileLabel
methods.description: Sets the SELinux label for a specific file path.

methods.name: SetFileCreateLabel
methods.description: Sets the default label for newly created files.

methods.name: Relabel
methods.description: Recursively relabels a path and its contents, optionally setting the level to s0 for sharing.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates that the label does not contain incompatible options (both 'z' and 'Z').

methods.name: RelabelNeeded
methods.description: Checks if relabeling is needed based on label options ('z' or 'Z').

methods.name: IsShared
methods.description: Determines if a label indicates shared content via the 'z' marker.
